rules.R1: Deadline is the Nth business day after today by band (A 12, B 9, C 7, D 5); weekends and the two holidays are skipped.
rules.R2: Each band's proposal limit (1/2/3/4) includes the opening full-amount-today ask, so post-opening proposals are limit minus one.
rules.R3: After the opening ask, the ladder is: full arrears on the week's last business day, full arrears on the deadline, floor on the deadline.
rules.R4: A ladder step identical (amount and date) to an earlier proposal, opening ask included, is skipped without being counted.
rules.R5: Floor is min_due for a store card and monthly_repayment for a loan.
rules.R6: Customer who refuses every allowed proposal is closed no_agreement / refused.
